description: This file contains utility functions for verifying the URL resolution of the `/api/users` endpoint within a frontend project. It includes functions to construct the URL with optional organization overrides, log the URL for verification purposes, and perform simple smoke testing of the URL resolution.

methods.name: verifyUsersUrlResolution(organizationIdOverride = null)
methods.description: Constructs and logs the expected URL for the `/api/users` endpoint, optionally overriding the organization ID for testing purposes. It also verifies allowed query parameters during development.

methods.name: quickUsersResolutionSmoke()
methods.description: Performs a quick smoke test to log the URL resolution for a specific organization ID ('T0015') to verify correct URL formation.
